prompt:
Use the reference image for the world and existing characters: the same single big round dark iron hotpot (no dividers) full of glossy red chili oil broth, the same wooden table, bowls, warm lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant background, the same cooked beef roll character and the same flat tripe-sheet character (dark velvety papillae surface), and the same character design language (googly eyes with white eyeballs and black pupils, small toothless mouths, tiny arms and legs of their own material). Same camera: about 40 degrees above, wide framing showing about 90% of the pot including the rim and both handles. Chopsticks resting on the left rim. New moment, the two new main characters in the front-center of the pot: a cube of duck blood (鴨血): deep wine-red / dark burgundy, smooth glossy jelly-like surface with tiny fine pores on its cut face; and a cube of firm old tofu (老豆腐): creamy white with slightly rough surface, its lower half already stained orange-red by the chili oil. Both have googly eyes, small toothless mouths and tiny arms and legs of their own material. They sit side by side, shoulder to shoulder, half submerged in the bubbling broth like two old friends in a hot spring, each with a fresh green coriander (cilantro) leaf folded on its head like a little towel, eyes half closed, mouths open in a relaxed happy "ahhh", tiny arms resting on each other's shoulders. Bubbles rise around them, gentle steam. In the back of the pot, the cooked beef roll and the tripe sheet float relaxed and wave at them; a few chili and Sichuan peppercorn characters float around smiling. Photorealistic textures, glistening oil, warm red and amber tones, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No comic motion lines or symbols, no humans, no human hands, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
